name: Offline Cheap Text LLM BitNet
description: A cheap text brain for your whole computer, running entirely on your device. A Provider app: put it in your Providers folder, assign it to Cheapest text LLM in Settings → AI models, and every app that asks for cheap text uses it — no account, no key, nothing leaves your device. Built on llama.cpp (wllama) with Microsoft's BitNet b1.58 ternary weights arriving as a hash-pinned download.
